 Manage local PNG files and JSON sessions; commands never invoke image APIs.

│ --workspace                 <path>  [default:                                │
│                                     /Users/cillian/Documents/Github/Project… │
│ --install-completion                Install completion for the current       │
│                                     shell.                                   │
│ --show-completion                   Show completion for the current shell,   │
│                                     to copy it or customize the              │
│                                     installation.                            │
│ --help                              Show this message and exit.              │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ reference-add    Copy a static PNG/JPEG and record immutable reference       │
│                  provenance.                                                 │
│ palette-propose  Return validated palette candidates and revision without    │
│                  saving state.                                               │
│ palette-add      Append one selected PaletteContent JSON and make it active  │
│                  for new logos.                                              │
│ color-analyze    Append a fresh measurement from verified original PNG       │
│                  bytes.                                                      │
│ color-gallery    Publish a portable gallery of explicitly listed logos       │
│                  without changing state.                                     │
│ icon-presets     List six styles with conversational defaults, without       │
│                  writing session state.                                      │
│ icon-gallery     Publish chosen originals and their exact prompts without    │
│                  approval or state mutation.                                 │
│ compare-gallery  Compare explicit session/revision/artifact PNGs; keep       │
│                  originals and approvals intact.                             │
│ init             Create a new session from a JSON brief (revision 0).        │
│ list             List explicit session IDs, revisions, and selections,       │
│                  checking saved images.                                      │
│ show             Resume a session after verifying every image hash and       │
│                  decoded metadata.                                           │
│ prompt           Return a generation/edit prompt and exact local parent      │
│                  path; no image is generated.                                │
│ import           Import a real PNG returned by the host with its actual      │
│                  final prompt.                                               │
│ select           Select an explicit stored artifact ID.                      │
│ review           Record all explicit visual checks from JSON; never infer    │
